name: Hrothar Rune-Mountain
passives: Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
lore: Hrothar Rune-Mountain is a colossal Asgardian Titan shaped by oaths give war meaning; courage gives power form. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Steel, iron, rune markings, storm energy, mountain-forged mass, frost scars, thunder wounds. The silhouette must be colossal, non-human, readable on mobile, and unmistakably Asgardian.
developmentStatus: Playable data scaffold complete; artwork pending.
